tools.name: get_device
tools.description: Get full details for one device by its id from search_devices: a number for maxforlive.com catalogue devices, or a string starting with m4l_ for devices submitted to max4.live by their author.

tools.name: list_filters
tools.description: List the valid values for the type, license and sort filters of search_devices.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_devices" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search ~8,900 Max for Live devices for Ableton Live. Fuzzy full-text match (title/author/description, identical to max4.live) plus filters. Compose for natural language, e.g. "popular free MIDI devices from the last 2 weeks" -> type=[MIDI Effect,MIDI Generator,MIDI Transformation], license=[free], s" → after: "Search 9,000+ Max for Live devices for Ableton Live: the maxforlive.com catalogue (indexed until 2026-08-07) plus devices submitted to max4.live by their authors (origin "own", ids starting m4l_). Fuzzy full-text match (title/author/description, identical to max4.live) plus filters. Compose for natu"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
